name: Teamwork.com MCP Server
description: Lets AI tools manage Teamwork.com projects, tasks, time logs, people, help desk tickets, and Spaces pages via a hosted MCP server with role-scoped endpoints.

skills.name: Projects And Tasks
skills.description: Reads, creates, and updates projects, tasks, tags, milestones, and people in Teamwork.com Projects.

skills.name: Time Tracking
skills.description: Logs time, runs and pauses timers, and summarizes timelogs for budget reporting.

skills.name: Help Desk Tickets
skills.description: Works with Teamwork Desk tickets, customers, and help docs.

skills.name: Spaces Pages
skills.description: Reads and edits Teamwork Spaces spaces and pages.

skills.name: Role Profile Endpoints
skills.description: Offers project-manager, support, analyst, knowledge-manager, and ops endpoints that expose only matching tools.
